## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3006. The PVC `data-ledger-db-0` is stuck in Terminating state because the pod `ledger-db-0` is still running and actively using it. This is the Storage Object in Use Protection feature working as designed to prevent data loss. The fix is to terminate the pod (by deleting or scaling down the StatefulSet), which will allow the PVC finalizer to be automatically removed and the cleanup job to complete. I advised against manually removing the finalizer, as that would bypass the important data protection mechanism.
